field.label: Password
field.help: Stored passwords are never shown. Leave empty when editing to keep the current password.

field.label: Static IPv4 address
field.help: Optional fixed address for this user; must not overlap any dynamic pool.

field.label: Download limit (kbit/s)
field.help: Rate limit towards the subscriber; 0 = unlimited. Requires "Local user shaping" in General.

field.label: Upload limit (kbit/s)
field.help: Rate limit from the subscriber; 0 = unlimited. Requires "Local user shaping" in General.

field.label: Routed IPv6 prefix
field.help: Optional static IPv6 prefix (e.g. 2001:db8:1234::/56) routed towards this subscriber. Requires IPv6 and "Local user shaping" in General.

field.label: Expiration date
field.help: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date. From this day the account no longer authenticates and its active sessions are disconnected by the scheduled expiry job (see documentation for enabling the cron job).
